sloka: यथाशक्ति प्रदानेन स्नापनोच्छादनेन च ।नित्यं च प्रियवादेन तथा संवर्द्धनेन च ॥ २.१११.१०॥
transliteration: yathāśakti pradānena snāpanocchādanena ca ।nityaṁ ca priyavādena tathā saṁvarddhanena ca ॥ 2.111.10॥

translations.english: The course of action the parents always adopt in respect of their son, the benefits they confer on him according to their resources, the way they lull him to sleep and clothe him, the affectionate words they always speak to him and the way they bring him up all these cannot be repaid.
